examples.english: All the girls in the family are helping.

examples.arabic: بعد الحصة قابلوا المدرسة وقالت اهلا وسهلا يا بنات
examples.english: After class, they met the teacher, and she said "Welcome, girls."
examples.transliteration: Ba'd el-hessa abelo el-modarresa w alet ahlan wa sahlan ya banat.

examples.arabic: بياع الفُل، اللي كان شايل حلة كبيرة، ابتسم وقال بصوت عالي: صباح الخير يا ست البنات! تحبي تاكلي فُل سخن؟
examples.english: The ful vendor, who was carrying a large pot, smiled and said loudly: "Good morning, lady of all girls! Would you like to eat hot ful?"
examples.transliteration: Bayya3 el-ful, elly kan shayel 7ella kebira, ebtesem w 'al be-sout 3ali: "Sabah el-kheir ya sett el-banat! Te7ebbi takli ful sokhn?"
examples.storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili
